name: 2D Semantic Distillation Loss
definition: A loss function that distills aggregated semantic features S^{2D}_{sem} using novel-view features S^{2D}_{novel} as a teacher to minimize differences between them.
summary: The 2D Semantic Distillation Loss enhances semantic consistency in NeRFs by distilling 2D features into 3D fields, operating in semantic space rather than RGB.
